title: San Francisco City Tour in EV Volkswagen Van
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Easy loading / unloading for guests with limited mobility
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: A specially crafted, luxury tour developed to ensure guests experience as much of San Francisco as 3 short hours will allow. Local, expert guides will drive you through the city in all-electric VW ID Buzz Vans, sharing relevant historical facts and personal anecdotes along the way. This tour is purpose-built to provide a comfortable and comprehensive deep dive into as much of San Francisco as possible during your short visit to our city.
